What if computer use had version control?
Multiverse is a complete harness for computer use across containers. One starting state becomes independent Debian desktops.
Try different approaches in parallel. Work in native applications like Inkscape. Compare the outcomes, and keep the version that meets the task.
Every recorded state and transition joins the graph. See how paths branch, where they fail, and which steps they share.
When a verified path matches the task, replay it. Reuse the work already recorded instead of rebuilding the same sequence.
Need another attempt? Return to a saved checkpoint and branch again. Rewind restores supported saved state.
Automate the desktop. Explore alternatives. Reuse what works. Multiverse.
